test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'She.'

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• After studying the whole passage, it can be understood that the passage is talking about **'Bonnie Bergin' **who is a feminine character.
 
• We use **personal pronouns** in place of noun phrases.
 
• We often use them to refer back to people and things that we have already identified.
 
 
• **Example**: *Peter complained to the chef about the meal. **She** wasn’t very helpful so** he **spoke to the manager.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is 'She.'
 
• *​​*Correct phrase__: She* *later returned to the United States .......*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

__
 
• **Personal pronouns** show person and number.
 
• He, she, him and her show gender.
 
• They have different subject and object forms (except you, it and one which have only one form).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• ​पूरे पैसेज का अध्ययन करने के बाद, यह समझा जा सकता है कि पैसेज 'बोनी बर्गिन' के बारे में बात कर रहा है जो एक स्त्री चरित्र है।
 
• हम संज्ञा वाक्यांशों के स्थान पर personal pronouns का उपयोग करते हैं।
 
• हम अक्सर उनका उपयोग उन लोगों और चीजों को संदर्भित करने के लिए करते हैं जिन्हें हम पहले ही पहचान चुके हैं।
 
 
• Example: *Peter complained to the chef about the meal. She wasn’t very helpful so he spoke to the manager.*
 
 

54:T1632,

The correct answer is 'to begin.'
